liar_dataset_train_test.notes: LIAR contains political statements with nuanced partial truths (half-true, mostly-false). Style classifiers achieve modest scores.

isot_dataset_train_test.notes: ISOT contains long-form news articles; easily learns formal vs informal vocabulary.

cross_dataset_transfer_test.evaluated_on: Curated Indian WhatsApp forwards (IFND test subset)
cross_dataset_transfer_test.accuracy_drop: Drops from 88.5% to 54.1% without retrieval pipeline
cross_dataset_transfer_test.key_finding: Proves why classification alone fails on WhatsApp forwards: forwards use informal colloquial phrasing, mixed Indian languages, and lack journalistic structure. Fact-check retrieval is mandatory.

error_analysis.issue: Model flags high exclamation marks and caps as misinformation even when content is benign parody.
error_analysis.remedy: Signal weighting lowers false-positive rate when no debunking fact-check is registered.

error_analysis.case: Brand-new breaking news with urgent headlines
error_analysis.issue: Legitimate urgent disaster warnings may exhibit high caps and urgency markers.
error_analysis.remedy: Verdict outputs 'Unverified' instead of 'Likely False' unless backed by known fact-check.

error_analysis.issue: Pure English tokenizers miss Hindi words written in Roman script.
error_analysis.remedy: Multilingual keyword dictionaries and transliteration-aware regex.
